title: Xiaomi Open-Sources Robotics Foundation Model
summary: Xiaomi open-sourced its embodied-AI foundation model Xiaomi-Robotics-1 on August 5, 2026, releasing code, model weights, and benchmark evaluation scripts on GitHub and Hugging Face. The vision-language-action model was pre-trained on more than 100,000 hours of UMI (universal manipulation interface) trajectory data and post-trained on more than 10,000 hours of cross-embodiment manipulation data. Xiaomi first previewed the model in July 2026 as an "out-of-the-box" foundation model for mobile manipulation, and the August release covers the full pipeline from real-robot post-training through deployment. Checkpoints, including a 5B-parameter variant, are published under the XiaomiRobotics organization on Hugging Face.
whyItMatters: A consumer electronics manufacturer the size of Xiaomi open-sourcing a robot foundation model trained on six-figure hours of manipulation data gives independent researchers and smaller robotics teams a strong pretrained starting point without needing Xiaomi's own data-collection scale, and adds another large open VLA to a field that a year earlier was dominated by closed models from a handful of frontier labs. It also reflects a broader pattern among Chinese hardware manufacturers of using open-source foundation models to seed developer ecosystems around their robotics hardware.
